# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules fetch -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules fetch [<name>...]

Clone and initialize submodules that are not initialized, then run
'git fetch --tags --force --prune origin' in each of them. Tags moved on
the remote replace the local ones, which lets status and verify detect
them. Without names, every managed submodule is fetched. Git's progress
output goes to standard error.
